text: Presence.update/4 replaces the whole meta map, it doesn't merge: pass online_at and device along with typing or they're lost.
Channel and presence tests: mix test test/parley_web/channels test/parley/chat; run MIX_ENV=test mix ecto.reset once after pulling.
Typing indicators are broadcast over a separate PubSub topic 'typing:<room_id>' and are never stored in Presence.
Typing state lives in Presence metas (typing: true/false) on 'room:<id>'; the old 'typing:<room_id>' PubSub topic was deleted.
Typing indicator events are debounced server-side in RoomChannel with a 500ms Process.send_after timer.
Typing throttling is client-side in assets/js/hooks/typing_hook.js (2s); the server only enforces RateLimiter's 10 events/min cap.
Before pushing run mix format and mix credo --strict.
Pre-push is `mix check` (format, credo, dialyzer, sobelow); credo alone skips the sobelow security pass.
Keep the typing indicator a function component, not a LiveComponent; presence_diff re-renders would remount a stateful one.
socket.assigns only carries user_id; load the membership once in join/3 with Chat.get_membership!/2 and keep it in assigns.
iOS Safari autocorrect fires 'input' without 'keydown'; detect activity on the input event or swipes and autocorrect go unseen.
assert_push "presence_diff" needs an explicit 500ms timeout; CI is slower than laptops and flakes at the default 100ms.
RateLimiter keeps counters in a per-node ETS table keyed {user_id, event}; limits are per node, not cluster-wide.
assets/js/hooks/infinite_scroll.js loads 50 messages per page; keep it in sync with the limit in Chat.list_messages/2.
config/runtime.exs reads S3_BUCKET for attachments; uploads go straight to S3 with presigned URLs from AttachmentController.
Digest emails are Oban jobs (Parley.Workers.DigestEmail) on the :mailers queue with max_attempts 5.
Read receipts are buffered by ReadReceiptBuffer and flushed to message_reads every 5s.
GitHub OAuth goes through Ueberauth; the dev callback is http://localhost:4000/auth/github/callback.
Reactions are capped at 20 distinct emoji per message by a unique index; Chat.add_reaction/3 maps the constraint error.
Commit subjects: '<area>: <lowercase summary>', with areas like chat, room_live, channel, hooks, test.
Setup: asdf install (Erlang 27, Elixir 1.17), mix setup, then iex -S mix phx.server.
Deploys: fly deploy from main via GitHub Actions; migrations run in the release_command, not at boot.
Style with Tailwind classes in HEEx; assets/css/app.css holds only keyframes and third-party overrides.
Dialyzer PLTs are cached in priv/plts; delete that folder if dialyzer errors after an OTP upgrade.
